Fork of [antirez/youcam](https://github.com/antirez/youcam), adapted for Windows 11 x64. MIT license.

Download **YouCam.exe** below and run it. No installation needed. The ZIP also includes the README and license.

- Native C++ screen and webcam recording, with no additional runtime to install.
- Screen, area, window with optional webcam overlay, webcam only, and full-screen camera stage.
- Webcam cropping, shadows and an animated stage background.
- Full-resolution MP4 recording at a constant 30 fps, microphone audio and pause/resume.
- Choose any available webcam; the app remembers your choice without preferring a brand.

Videos are saved to your Desktop. System audio is not recorded. Windows N may need the Media Feature Pack.
